notes.title: Game Update 4th April
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

The team is pleased to announce the latest update for Breakneck which includes:

Research Zone
A brand new environment has been added into the game to provide new challenges for players. Master these new zones to claim the highest score!

Controller Bug Fix
The game should now save your controller binding settings.

Miscellaneous
Various bug fixes in zones and graphics improvements.

Hope you are now ready to jump back into some epic racing action!

Best regards,
PikPok
